race.comment: COSMIC JINKS (9) rode the speed at Port Macquarie and gave them a galloping lesson. She was expected to do that given the price she started however her form warranted that. She can cross over quickly and try to control it again. EEZITOSORT (5) could well try to kick up and lead once more. She did that to good effect before a spell. Had one trial before this effort. SONG FOR ROSIE (3) will be resuming but ran some honest races in tougher Class 1s. May well be looking for a softer track. MAGIC STORM (11) has the confidence of a win on debut. Won't get much of a different situation from this barrier. SUPIDO STAR (2) does tend to settle back and might give away some ground to favoured runners. Probably rails home.
